baseline: public-tactical-v1-blocked-lethal-canonical-monster-id: deterministic normal-public policy using visible intent, approximate native static card base damage, visible player/monster status and HP, a small named block-card estimate table, and energy cost; lethal priority compares estimated HP damage after visible target block with current HP; critical defense prioritized; Powers receive a frozen score deferral when a living monster has public id_label GREMLIN_NOB, and otherwise are favored mainly in visible non-attacking windows; Blood/Block potions used only at documented HP-risk thresholds and Fire Potion only on visible lethal; all other potions held; generic selection uses first legal option
baseline_damage_estimate_limit: static native per-hit base damage with public strength/weak/vulnerable and target block; does not model multi-hit counts, area effects, or card-specific effects, so lethal priorities are approximate and native transitions determine actual outcomes
budget_semantics: total shared-tree simulations per actual public decision; not multiplied by particle count; particle index cycles simulation_index modulo 32
cohort_generation: prospectively fixed Ironclad A20 game seeds 49..72 inclusive (24 independent game-seed clusters), untouched by Issues #14, #15, and #16; on the visible Act 1 map follow a shortest reachable route to the earliest Elite, breaking ties toward more rest nodes and fewer intervening Monsters; elsewhere choose the first legal game action; use public-tactical-v1-blocked-lethal-canonical-monster-id in prelude battles; retain every seed including setup losses, unsupported states, and setup failures
controller: adaptive shared-public-tree UCT, one tree per decision and 32 sampled particles
cost_breakdown_method: exclusive call timers for particle construction, partial public projection/history-key work, UCT edge selection, and native transitions; bookkeeping between these regions is not assigned to a phase, so components need not sum to total search wall time
decision_seed_derivation: For each decision, splitMix64(base XOR splitMix64(game_seed) XOR splitMix64(replicate_seed) XOR splitMix64(decision_index)); sampler and search use separate fixed base constants, and every realized decision seed is recorded in its attempt row
historical_development_outcome_note: Issues #14–16 exposed seeds are development history and are not pooled or treated as evidence for this prospective cohort
latency_summary_semantics: elapsed_battle_wall covers the actual target battle loop from the restored public start through terminal or stop status, for target starts only; controller_action_wall excludes the baseline sampler-support probe; decision wall samples include every attempted controller decision, including unsupported and controller-error decisions; search wall and phase samples include only decisions where search ran
leaf_evaluation: terminal battle win/loss is +1/-1; at 24 public-action decisions clamp(player_hp/max_hp - 0.5 * sum(monster_hp/max_hp), -1, 1) using public state
limitations: fixed prospective seed cohort has 24 A20 setup attempts; seed attempts that lose before the target Elite remain in denominators
target starts are Act 1 Elites reached through a deterministic public-heuristic prelude and do not represent a complete run or broad A20 claim
the new comparator is a hand-built public tactical heuristic, not an Oracle or certified strong player; its static card damage proxy omits multihit counts, area effects, and card-specific modifiers
paired battles share the same complete initial state and seed, but future random streams may diverge after actions differ
sampler-unsupported search attempts stop without fallback and are not counted as defeats
search rollouts truncate at 24 public-action decisions with a public HP-fraction heuristic
wall times are local single-process measurements and exclude compilation
small clustered cohort and support-conditioned outcomes do not establish statistical significance or policy strength
paired_outcome_semantics: Paired win deltas use terminal battle pairs. Paired HP-loss deltas include both terminal wins and losses, not only wins. Setup failures and incomplete or sampler-unsupported attempts remain in the all-attempt summaries and are not recoded as defeats.
pairing: For each fixed game seed, prepare the target once before controller outcomes and capture one authoritative full simulator checkpoint. Each policy restores a copy of that exact checkpoint; the complete public start identity is rechecked after restore. Later RNG streams may diverge after different actions.
profile_sample_rationale: Fixed purposive sample from already-exposed Issue 17 seeds: seed 63 is a lower-cost ordinary GREMLIN_NOB battle; seed 54 is a slower LAGAVULIN battle. Used only for cost profiling, not outcome estimation.
sampler_interpretation: reproducible proposal distribution, not an exact posterior
scientific_status: purposive exposed-seed performance profile; no outcome claim
target_battle_start: first naturally reached Act 1 Elite battle from the fixed native seeded run
uncertainty_method: For paired effects, average controller replicate effects within each game seed, then bootstrap complete game-seed clusters with replacement (10,000 replicates, fixed bootstrap seed); percentile intervals describe this small fixed cohort and are not a confirmatory significance claim.
work_counter_definition: native public-action steps count step_public_action calls in sampled search trajectories plus real controller actions; simulator-internal queue steps are not separately instrumented
